claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Fluocinonide is a potent topical glucocorticoid that at 2.5 uM is expected to produce little or no direct cytotoxicity in a 5-day pooled viability screen; any antiproliferative effect would reflect weak, non-selective glucocorticoid receptor-mediated growth inhibition rather than a dominant cytotoxic mechanism.
